messages:
elaine: Noticed a weird pattern on latency dashboard: p50 & p95 steady but p99 for /v1/complete (widget-mini) jumps and sometimes lower than p95 in UI. Anyone else?
samir: yep. looks tied to yesterday's quota reshuffle that nudged some clients into fallback route. small cohort.
priya: backend raw p99=180ms, console shows p99=160ms and p95=200ms — UI inversion. probably mixed provenance.
metrics-bot: MET-archive: collect provenance traces for widget-mini slice.
elaine: traces show transport_time spikes on fallback path. service_time unchanged. charting mixes origins so labels are misleading.
samir: we need three fixes: 1) confidence badge when sample_count<50; 2) provenance tag next to each percentile (raw|rollup|origin=...); 3) per-origin toggle (ingress/proxy/backend) in the latency card.
priya: also alter alerting: scale down severity or require min_samples before paging. noisy p99 pages are expensive.
ops-bot: Proposal logged: OPS-122 - sample-aware p99 alerting.
elaine: short-term: can the frontend hide inconsistent percentiles and show a warning: "percentile sources differ for this slice"? saves support tickets.
samir: yes, quick patch: if provenance keys differ, collapse values and show provenance modal with raw sample list. I'll PR.
priya: telemetry action: add API param ?origin= to percentiles endpoint so infra tests can assert backend-only p99.
metrics-bot: MET-780 created for origin filter.
elaine: adding repro snippet for lab: 
```bash
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete?prefix=widget-mini-test"; done | sort -n | tail -n 20
```
priya: UX wording for badge: "Low sample — percentile may be unstable (N=<count>)". Also add in rollout UI: "Routing weight change may increase transport variance for small cohorts".
samir: agree. will add rollout interstitial when fallback weight increases >3%.
elaine: ok plan: frontend hide + provenance tag -> staging; telemetry origin param -> API; alerting degrade severity for N<30. monitor 48h. I'll file a follow-up if inversion persists. :thumbsup:
